stem.text: In the high temperatures of car engines, nitrogen reacts with oxygen to give nitrogen monoxide.
Which reaction pathway diagram could correctly represent this reaction?

A.alt: Energy profile: reactant level with an Ea peak above it; NO(g) product level lies below the reactant level; a ΔH arrow joins the two levels.

B.alt: Energy profile: Ea arrow drawn from the NO(g) product level to an Ea peak; NO(g) level lies above the reactant level; ΔH arrow from the reactant level up to NO(g).

C.alt: Energy profile: Ea arrow drawn upward from the reactant level to an Ea peak; NO(g) product level lies above the reactant level; ΔH arrow from the reactant level up to NO(g).

D.alt: Energy profile: Ea arrow drawn downward from an Ea peak to the reactant level; NO(g) product level lies above the reactant level; ΔH arrow from the reactant level up to NO(g).
